sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Irrigation and Drainage Authority Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN
IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Irrigation and drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 2000]
No. Legis. 1-110/Law/96-II,
dated 17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Irrigation
and Drainage Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of

No. Legis. 1-110/Law/96-II,
dated 17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of section 26 of
Act I of 1997.--In the Balochistan Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act,
1997, hereinafter .referred to as the said Act, in section 26:--
(a) in
subsection (2), for the words "Accountant-General for the Province"
the words "Auditor-General of Pakistan" shall be substituted.
(b) in
subsection (4) for the words "Accountant-General for the Province"
the words "Auditor-General of Pakistan" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Irrigation and Drainage Authority Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 32 of the Act I of 1997

ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN
IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Irrigation and drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 17th November, 2000]
No. Legis. 1-110/Law/96-II,
dated 17-11-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 13th November, 2000, is hereby published for general
information:--
3. Amendment of section 32 of
the Act I of 1997.--In the said Act, section 32, shall be re-numbered as
subsection (1), and thereafter subsection (2) shall be added, namely:--
(2) Such bye laws or regulations
may provide for,
(a) delineation
of the territorial jurisdiction of the Farmer's Organization and the manner of
their constitution;
(b) manner and
procedure of their registration, suspension, cancellation of such registration,
and dissolution of the Farmers Organizations;
(c) membership
of Farmers Organizations, qualifications disqualifications and method of
election of such members;
(d) manner and
procedure of adjudication of election disputes;
(e)
establishment of Irrigation Tribunals and Irrigation Appellate Tribunals, for
the adjudication of election and other disputes; qualifications, powers and
jurisdictions of such tribunals.
(f)
establishment of Nahri panchayats, their powers and jurisdictions, and
(g) to provide
for the establishment of fund of the Farmer's Organization, manner of
utilization of such fund; auditing of accounts of the Farmer's Organization and
other matters relating to finances of the Farmer's Organization.
